[[File:DuracreteSlugCoruscant-FFp48.png|thumb|right|250px|A duracrete slug on the streets of Coruscant.]]
'''Silica parasites''' consisted of [[Granite slug/Legends|granite slugs]], [[duracrete worm]]s, [[Duracrete slug/Legends|duracrete slugs]], and [[shadow barnacle]]s that thrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were invertebrates that fed upon building structures. They were very destructive, annually causing millions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] worth of damage.
